_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Import finished — check forHumans for the preview link.

description: Import URL to draft. Waits up to ~40 s; if still running it returns the job id, progress, warnings and `next` (get_site_tasks). On complete it may include requiredDecision: mirror vs editable; ask the person after they see the preview, before any structure_* call.

keyConvention.description: Content key shape: directory = Astro dist (about/index.html); default flat

mode.description: Default auto — per-page mirror with silent render escalation

pages.description: Explicit page list; omit to import sourceUrl as index.html

segments.description: Split-origin segments; each expands into pages from its own `sitemap` (without one: only its pathPrefix hub page).

sitemap.description: Sitemap path relative to sourceUrl, e.g. /designs/sitemap.xml. Without it only the segment's hub page is imported (warning segment_hub_only).

workspace.description: Workspace id or slug; only with several workspaces.

name: import_site_from_url
